3. SAVING SETTINGS AND CLOSING THE MENU

Once the configuration settings are changed in either the System or Game Configuration Menus, move the arrow to the EXIT option in each respective menu and press the Player 1 JAB PUNCH button. This will return you to the Configuration Menu. At the Configuration Menu move the arrow to 4. SAVE & EXIT and press the Player 1 JAB PUNCH button. You will be returned to the Test Menu. A message “SAVING NEW CONFIGURATION IN EEPROM” appears while new settings are being saved. It takes one or two seconds to save the new settings. Do not tum off the power switch while saving is in process. From the Test Menu move the arrow to 9. EXIT and press the Player 1 JAB PUNCH button. This will return you to game mode.
